title: Grateful Dead Live at Hartford Civic Center on 1983-10-14
lineage: MAC: Sony TC-D5M >Edirol UA5 Custom Oade Mod>USB>IBM R40>Sound Forge>CDR>EAC(no errors)>WinXP Pro>Flac Frontend>FLAC16.
source: 2 Nak 700's>Sony TC-D5M>Maxell MX90 (1st set), TDK MA90 (2nd set) Mic Config: 10 feet high, pointed towards stacks. Location: 3 rows behind soundboard, DFC

ai_review.summary: Excellent soundboard capture of a classic 1983 show, featuring a solid first set and an energetic second‑set extravaganza.
ai_review.review: Both reviewers rave about this recording, praising its clear bottom end and overall superb audio quality. The performance is described as “awesome” with a tight first set and a fast‑moving, high‑energy second set that typifies the strong 1983 tour. No flaws are noted, making it a must‑listen for fans of that era.

ai_rating.rationale: Consistently five‑star ratings and uniformly positive comments on both the music and the sound quality indicate an outstanding show captured with excellent recording fidelity.

recording_quality.technical_notes: Very good recording with nice bottom end; no reported distortion, drop‑outs, or balance issues.

show_quality.setlist_flow: Solid first set followed by a fast‑paced, high‑energy second‑set extravaganza typical of the 1983 tour.
